m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Ah! So the Inspectors have out professionaled the professional, eh? And you think you can clean out the Cleaner? To arms then!
Wait, what? You weren't hired by the Inspectors? Gorbeau sent you to help me? How unprofessional! Actually, I suppose I could use a hand.
After watching the Inspectors Brigade for weeks, I suspect the dirty Inspector is Commissionaire Maladay. But I still need hard evidence.
If I can get ahold of the Empress' Financial Logs I believe I'll find proof of illegal payments to the crooked Inspector.
I should keep watch here. Can you get the Financial Logs from the Imperial Records? You will? Merci et bonne chance!
My goodness, you look a bit of a mess, Wizard! Were you able to sweep up the Financial Logs? Yes? Let me see them!
Mhmm... Fish imports... huh, apparently the Empress buys very expensive triple-padded therapeutic pillows... Aha, this is it!
There are hundreds of payments from the Imperial Treasury to Commissionaire Maladay's personal account, listed simply as 'Bribe'.
Apparently subtlety is a lost art. This confirms the Empress illegally bribed the Inspectors to turn on their Pingouin brethren.
All that's left is to take this evidence to the Inspectors Brigade and expose Maladay for the dirty crook he is. Allons-y!
Well, my featherless friend, your short apprenticeship is almost complete. Come, let us give the Inspectors Brigade a proper cleaning!
Attention Inspectors: You are a stain on the pride of your fellow Pingouins and I am the Cleaner. Prepare to be cleaned!
You mindless peons shall not suffer for the crime of following orders. Commissionaire Maladay is the tarnished party here.
Maladay sold you out to the Empress! Arrest him! Cleanse the Inspectors Brigade of the stain of his treachery! For the good of all Pingouins!
Monsieur, I assure you we are professionals! We have proof that the Empress paid you to spy on and bully the Pingouins.
Wizard, let's put this sullied sellout through the ringer!
Ha ha! Come, Wizard, let us inform Gorbeau that the Inspectors Brigade has been professionally cleaned!
And maybe we'll get some stroganoff too.
As you should be. But it would be unprofessional of me to take all the credit. The Wizard did a fair share of the scrubbing.
Wizard! Léon! Please tell me you've cleansed the Inspectors Brigade of the dirty traitor.
You did? Fantastique! I'm sorry I doubted your cleaning skills, Léon.
The Pingouins of Walruskberg are in debt to both of you. Well, not so much to you, Léon. You already got your money.
As for you, Wizard, I wish I had more to give you. But you'll never pay for stroganoff as long as I'm running this place!
You've been a great help to us Pingouins, Wizard. Any chance you'd be willing to lend your talents to help clean up the Inspectors Brigade?
The Inspectors weren't always so cruel and overbearing. Someone in their organization sold them out to the Empress.
I hired a professional named Léon to investigate and... clean up the Inspectors Brigade, so to speak. But I haven't heard from him.
Léon told me he planned to surveil the Inspectors from a house across from the First Precinct. Will you go help Léon finish his 'cleaning'?
We're fed up with the Inspectors Brigade's filthy spying and bullying. Go help Léon, the professional I hired to clean them up!
